recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: karl the fog swallowing golden gate mornings at thirteen degrees
your old selfies resurfacing inside someone else's glasses ad
newton's laws compiled fresh for a windows xp desktop
owned films vanishing from digital shelves overnight
stutter-house pulses threading through a swedish pop summer
agents spinning up from a phone shortcut before sunrise

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Surf the fog bank above San Francisco — one thumb switches lanes between three invisible currents, catching warm updrafts before the cold layer collapses.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: swipe left/right to hop between fog lanes
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Each lane holds a different wind speed; chaining three warm updrafts in a row triggers a brief golden-hour burst.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: Fog thickens every ten seconds, lanes narrow, and updrafts appear in shorter windows.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: soft gray watercolor with a single amber sun disc bleeding through

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: A stutter-house rhythm toy where sample slices stutter on the beat — tap to lock a loop, release to let Fred-again-style chops cascade into the next bar.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: hold to loop a beat slice, release on the downbeat to stutter into the next
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Perfect releases stack 'ten' counters that remix the backing track live for sixty seconds.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: BPM creeps up and off-beat slices turn to static unless you re-sync with a double-tap.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon waveform scribbles on black club-floor tiles

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Your digital movie shelf is deleting itself — drag tiles into a 'kept' vault before the store pulls them, sorting by genre under a ticking refund timer.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag film tiles into genre bins before they fade out
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Saving a full genre row before the wipe earns a replay clip of the 'lost' poster art.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Tiles vanish faster, bins shuffle positions, and duplicate genres split your attention.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: flat playstation-store UI with VHS scan lines and red 'removed' stamps

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick apples off a Windows XP desktop to prove gravity — each successful arc writes another line of Principia onto a scrolling parchment.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: flick to launch objects; drag to aim the next apple
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Three clean parabolas in a row unlock a satisfying 'QED' stamp and XP startup chime.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Wind gusts, moving targets, and clutter on the taskbar block your trajectories.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: pixel-perfect XP bliss with yellow sticky-note physics overlays
